wickermoor_hollow_s45.prompt: A hand-painted bird's-eye view map of the cursed folk-horror valley of Wickermoor Hollow at night, one continuous painted landscape seen from above, filling the whole picture edge to edge, no border, no labels, no lettering, no text: a dark moonlit moor in the middle with a ring of crooked cottages round one huge pale oak, a crooked purple manor on a hill just north-east of it, a wrecked red train with smoke on the moor to the north-west, a toxic teal fungal forest in the far north-west corner, snowy mountain peaks and a mine headframe in the hills to the north-west, a dark still lake with a pale sanatorium on a small island and a stone monastery on its shore to the west, golden cornfields with a windmill to the east, a walled cemetery with leaning tombstones in mist to the south-east, a black bayou swamp with a riverboat in the far south, a winding silver river and tan dirt roads joining the places.
